messages:
Talia Brooks: Hey team — quick kickoff for Sundial Health onboarding. Objective: pilot live in 30 days, capture renewal risk early, and set a lightweight feedback loop. Who can take what? :wave:
Jon Miller: I can own API integration and smoke tests. Plan to run an auth + request dry-run by day 3.
Priya Rao: I'll run enablement & playbook (two 40m sessions: integration + prompts). Propose session 1 in week 1, session 2 in week 2.
Ezekiel Wu: Data & compliance here. Need sample payloads, DPA, and SOC2. If theres PHI flagged, we'll push redaction and retention defaults.
Talia Brooks: I requested SOC2/DPA in the welcome email. Will escalate to their security lead if no reply in 48h. Exec sponsor is currently unassigned; recommend we get an intro before week 2.
Jon Miller: Infra suggestion: start small Dedicated pool, batch size 6, prefix cache on. That should hit p95 latency targets without overprovisioning.
Priya Rao: Enablement checklist (v0):
- Day 0: Stakeholder intros + roles
- Day 2: API walkthrough + keys
- Day 6: Prompt tuning + 10-case eval
- Day 12: Failover & monitoring runbook
- Day 30: Pilot review + renewal conversation
I'll upload slides after session 1.
Ezekiel Wu: Risk notes: renewal-risk: medium (procurement timeline unclear). Data-risk: potential sensitive fields; I'll draft redaction/KMS options in 48h.
Talia Brooks: Success criteria suggestion: 1) 3 core flows pass (functionally), 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) error rate < 1% and spend estimate within agreed pilot cap. Thoughts?
Jon Miller: Agree. Also add an ops alert for token spend > 120% projected. I'll wire that into the ticket.
Priya Rao: Feedback loop: shared sheet for issues + a weekly 30-min sync during pilot. I'll create and share the sheet within 24h.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "Sundial Health - Onboarding Huddle" scheduled 2025-10-14 14:00 PDT (invite sent).
Talia Brooks: Action items recap:
- Talia: secure exec intro + chase SOC2/DPA (today)
- Jon: dry-run smoke tests + post examples (day 3)
- Priya: publish enablement schedule + eval set (wk1)
- Ezekiel: redaction plan + KMS notes (48h)
If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
